outcome.answer: For MLLMs, AWARe assigns activation-based importance scores and selectively freezes parameters important for preserving prior capabilities, while allowing less important parameters to adapt [2]. Model-Dowser instead scores parameters using weight magnitudes, input activations, and output sensitivities, then preserves high-importance parameters during sparse fine-tuning [4]. Both methods aim to mitigate catastrophic forgetting while adapting MLLMs to downstream tasks [2, 4].
